description: This is a Java test class for the IdempotencyCommandProcessFailedException, which tests the behavior of the IdempotentCommandExceptionMapper when handling an IdempotentCommandProcessFailedException, including setting proper HTTP response status and headers.

classes.name: IdempotencyCommandProcessFailedExceptionTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying behavior of IdempotentCommandProcessFailedException and its handling via IdempotentCommandExceptionMapper.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes thread-local context with tenant, action, and business date before each test execution.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test execution.

methods.name: testInconsistentStatus
methods.description: Creates an exception and verifies that the Response returned by the mapper has status 500 and proper header indicating idempotency cache status.
